# The Paw District

> The Paw District is a pet-care destination in Chennai offering pet boarding, professional grooming and practical dog training.

Official website: https://www.thepawdistrict.in

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/): Overview of The Paw District and its pet-care services.
- [About](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/about): The business's approach and care standards.
- [Why Paw District](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/why-paw-district): What pet parents can expect.
- [Regular care](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/membership): How to discuss recurring care needs.
- [FAQ](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Visit](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/visit): Verified contact information, address and directions.

## Services

- [Pet boarding](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/services/boarding): Overnight and daytime boarding information.
- [Pet grooming](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/services/grooming): Dog and cat grooming information.
- [Dog training](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/services/training): Practical training and pet-parent coaching.

## Resources

- [Journal](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/blog): General pet-care articles.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/privacy): Website data and analytics information.
- [Terms](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/terms): Website and enquiry terms.
- [Sitemap](https://www.thepawdistrict.in/sitemap.xml): Discoverable website pages.

## Location

No. 20/4A1A3, Mappedu Road, Alapakkam - Nedunkundram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600063, India.
